title: ScreenerRecord
description: Canonical schema for one company record scraped from Screener.in

company_name.description: Full company name as displayed on Screener.in

ticker.description: NSE or BSE ticker symbol (e.g. INFY)

dividend_yield_pct.description: Dividend yield as a percentage (e.g. 3.5 means 3.5%)

scraped_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the scrape completed (ISO 8601)

source_url.description: Full URL of the screen that was scraped

roce_pct.description: Return on capital employed as a percentage (optional)

roe_pct.description: Return on equity as a percentage (optional)
